environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (i-0a3f8b2c1d4e5f6a7) in us-east-1, exposed directly via public Elastic IP 54.210.xx.xx on port 8080. Security group sg-0abc123 allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy, WAF, or load balancer in front of the service. The application serves as an internal user lookup microservice but was accidentally exposed publicly during a migration.
